sources.why: Even G2 facts in data/devices/even-g2.json and the records in data/records/even-g2 were checked against this SDK.
The manifest check leaves to evenhub pack what the CLI validates. See the store notes in data/devices/even-g2.json and data/records/even-g2/examples-declare-sdk-below-store-floor.json.
Simulator evidence in data/records/even-g2 was gathered with this simulator. Rerun scripts/probes/even-simulator.mjs.
The official templates are cited in data/records/even-g2. Lint the changed templates with --manifest and check the records that cite them.
The official Even skills are cited in data/records/even-g2. Check the records that cite a changed skill.
The store rules in data/devices/even-g2.json come from this page.
The manifest format and the network whitelist note in data/devices/even-g2.json come from this page.
An official skill that imports a name the SDK does not export produces an app that does not build. See data/records/even-g2/background-state-skill-missing-api.json.
The timer probe for data/records/even-g2/sdk-timer-id-collision.json, run on the latest SDK. A change means the record needs new evidence, or fixedIn.
Meta Ray-Ban Display facts in data/devices/mrbd.json come from this file.
